title: Work head displacement bound
statement: Let $M$ be a $k$-work-tape Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on a Boolean input $x$, let $t\in\mathbb N$, and let $i$ be a work-tape index. After $t$ steps, the position of work-tape head $i$ lies between its initial position minus $t$ and its initial position plus $t$, inclusive.
